name: Amsterdam
description: A bar and New American restaurant on West Main Street in Patchogue village that replaced That Meetball Place in late 2025. Cover bands play Friday and Saturday nights from 7:30 PM, then a DJ keeps the party going late.

dancing.notes: The venue sells its weekends as dinner that turns into a dance party: a band on a raised stage at 7:30 PM, then a DJ at 10:30 PM. Party cover bands are booked, and band listings promise a moving dance floor. Expect freestyle dancing to rock, funk and 80s and 90s hits.

evidence.note: Official site promotes live bands every Friday and Saturday at 7:30 PM and a DJ from 10:30 PM, under the heading that dinner meets the dance floor.
Nov 2025 local news: the former Meetball Place was rebuilt as Amsterdam with a raised platform for live music and a focus on bands and DJs.
Band night listing for Slingshot Jams at Amsterdam describes a high-energy dance party with a busy dance floor after happy hour.
June 12, 2026 event billed as a Friday night dance party with a live band and a DJ.
